remarks: Bright, sunny, and beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath townhouse in a sought-after complex with pool! Perfectly positioned in one of the best locations in the community, this home offers rare privacy with serene views of the trees. Stylish and move-in ready, it features designer details throughout - custom moldings, built-in speakers, Nest thermostat and WiFi-enabled security. The open-concept main level is filled with natural light and flows to a private balcony, ideal for morning coffee or relaxing after work. The updated kitchen offers sleek finishes and great storage, while both bedrooms are spacious and inviting. Enjoy central air, in-unit laundry with new washer and dryer, and assigned parking. Tons of storage in the pull-down attic! Prime location just steps to public transportation and an easy walk to The SoNo Collection, trendy restaurants, and waterfront attractions. A perfect blend of style, privacy, and convenience - ideal for commuters and anyone looking to enjoy the best of this wonderfully convenient location!
